agent_evaluations.detailed_comments: This OSCE station fails to meet AMC Clinical Examination standards for radiology interpretation stations due to generic placeholder content. Expected answers provide no actual radiological interpretation - a candidate reading 'The investigations show findings consistent with Viral Pneumonia' gains no educational value and cannot pass an AMC imaging station (which requires systematic approach + specific findings identification). The CXR image is provided but no guidance exists on what to look for (bilateral interstitial infiltrates, ground-glass opacities, vs lobar consolidation). Systematic ABCDE approach is absent. Australian clinical context is weak (no eTG/TSANZ reference). Vital signs are copy-pasted (identical BP/HR/RR/SpO2/Temp across 50 different respiratory cases - clinically impossible). This appears to be template-generated content without medical expert review. CRITICAL: All 50 OSCEs in this batch likely suffer the same issue (generic placeholders, no systematic interpretation frameworks). Recommend complete content regeneration with actual radiological interpretations, systematic approaches (ABCDE for CXR), and Australian guideline-based management (eTG Respiratory, TSANZ, RANZCR Imaging Pathways). Current quality: educational value 3/10, clinical realism 4/10, AMC readiness 2/10.
